content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired for gpu-node-47 (hostkick). Reason: kernel panic detected, kubelet not responding. PagerDuty incident: PD-8942

Maya Patel: Acked. I'm on call.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Maya Patel at 2026-03-15T02:34:12Z

Maya Patel: Can someone check serial console / IPMI first? don't run drain yet until we confirm pod state.

Jordan Lee: looking. serial console shows repeated "kernel: NMI: watchdog: BUG: soft lockup" + gpu driver Xid 79 sequence. past logs attached.

Jordan Lee: paste: ```kernel: [ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus```

Priya Kapoor: If kubelet is down we should cordon and try graceful eviction for serving pods. Which tenants are on that node?

Ben Ortiz: I see two prod model-serving replicas on that node (redwood-prod/transformer-infer v27) and one batch job. Could be customer impact for low-volume customers on dedicated pool.

Maya Patel: Ok - cordon and try eviction with 5m grace. Jordan can you run: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-47 && kubectl drain gpu-node-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300```

Jordan Lee: running now. If kubelet is unresponsive drain might hang; will force delete pods if they don't terminate after 2m.

incident-bot: Action logged: node cordon requested by Jordan Lee.

Maya Patel: Start customer-impact check. Priya, can you run quick alert to SRE slack #customer-impact with list of potentially affected tenants? mention any Dedicated contracts.

Priya Kapoor: pinging SRE -> "Heads up: potential impact: 2 low-tier dedicated tenants on gpu-node-47; 1 batch job. No enterprise SLA flagged yet. Will escalate if error rates rise >3x." :eyes:

Ben Ortiz: Also checking routing: autoscaler should place replacements but if quota full might backlog.

Jordan Lee: drain stuck on kubelet connection timed out. Doing force delete of stuck pods: ```kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-47 -n redwood-prod``` then ```kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=30 --force --namespace redwood-prod```

Maya Patel: Good. After pods removed, start replacement in same pool. Watch rollout for errors.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation to Priya Kapoor (on-call lead) at 2026-03-15T02:36:40Z

Priya Kapoor: I'm watching metrics. I see a small spike in 429/timeout for transformer-infer on region-us-east-1, about 2.8x baseline. Not yet customer-visible SLA breach but trending.

Jordan Lee: Serial console shows multiple kernel oops entries; looks like NVMe IO errors before Xid 79. Possible hardware fault. I'm requesting BMC power cycle now (IPMI).

Ben Ortiz: Noted. I'm flagging RMA with colo. Putting host in 'maintenance' in the inventory.

Maya Patel: Actions summary: 1) cordon + force-evict done, 2) pods rescheduled, 3) BMC power cycle in progress, 4) monitoring for increased errors. Priya, if error rate crosses threshold open an incident P1.

Priya Kapoor: Will do. Setting an alert: if error rate >3x for 10m -> escalate to oncall-eng and account-ops.

Jordan Lee: powercycle finished. Node came back to network but kubelet still failing to start: kubelet logs show: ```failed to start kubelet: could not init cgroups: permission denied``` -- looks like kernel corrupted state.

Maya Patel: Ok, RMA required. For now leave node cordoned and tainted to prevent scheduling: ```kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-47 node.kubernetes.io/unavailable:NoSchedule```

Ben Ortiz: Taint applied. Inventory note created: serial number SN-9X47 flagged for RMA. Colocation ticket #COL-3321 opened.

Priya Kapoor: Customer impact update -> brief blip for a subset of low-tier dedicated customers; no enterprise SLAs affected. Posting to status.redwood.ai with initial note: "We experienced an infrastructure host failure affecting a small number of inference workloads. Engineers are mitigating; some requests may have seen increased latency or transient errors."

Maya Patel: Good. Assigning post-incident owner: Jordan will take lead for hardware diagnosis + postmortem writeup, Priya will coordinate customer comms.

Jordan Lee: noted. Will capture serial console, dmesg, and nvme SMART, and timeline.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8942 updated: acknowledged -> mitigated (pods evacuated), RMA pending.

Maya Patel: Any follow-ups before I hand to daytime rotation?

Ben Ortiz: I'll follow up with colo for RMA ETA in morning. leaving some notes in the ticket.

Priya Kapoor: I'll craft the status update and follow-up with impacted tenants.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Handing off to Priya for watch. Maya out. :wave:
